Title: Azure Functions Premium plan is now available in 16 new regions

Body.Content:
Run serverless function apps with no cold-start, virtual network connectivity, and larger instance sizes with the Azure Functions Premium plan. The plan supports running on either Windows-based or Linux-based instances, and is now available in these 16 new regions:

Linux

  • Australia East
  • Brazil South
  • Canada Central
  • Central US
  • East Asia
  • East US 2
  • France Central
  • Japan West
  • Korea Central
  • North Central US
  • Norway East
  • UK South
  • UK West
  • West India
  • West Central US
  • West US 2

Windows

  • Norway East
  • West Central US

 

Learn more about the Premium plan. 

See the complete list of supported regions.
